name: danfo-craze-app
description: Danfo Craze native app (Android + iOS) wrapping the web game in ../danfo-driver

scripts.sync: npm run web:dev && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:release: npm run web:release && npx cap sync
scripts.native:setup: npx cap add android; npx cap add ios; python3 scripts/patch-native.py && node scripts/make-icons.cjs && npx cap sync
